verdict.rationale: Capacities' AI privacy docs state that AI features are fully opt-in and that, unless AI is activated, no space data is shared with any third-party AI services. That gives users a first-party way to keep their data away from AI providers, but the evidence never explicitly addresses model training. missing for 10: an explicit no-training commitment from Capacities and its AI providers, a training opt-out that still lets users use AI features, independent corroboration.
